scripts.build: npm run build:public && npm run build:backoffice && npm run build:member
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend && npm run build && npm run cloudflare:check
scripts.cloudflare:d1:generate: npm run cloudflare:d1:schema && npx prisma generate --schema backend/prisma-d1/schema.prisma --config backend/prisma-d1/prisma.config.ts
scripts.cloudflare:d1:migrate:local: npm run cloudflare:d1:generate && npx wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local --config backend/wrangler.jsonc --env-file backend/cloudflare.env
scripts.cloudflare:types: npx wrangler types backend/src/cloudflare/env.d.ts --config backend/wrangler.jsonc --env-file backend/cloudflare.env
scripts.cloudflare:dev: npm run cloudflare:d1:migrate:local && npm run cloudflare:types && npx wrangler dev --config backend/wrangler.jsonc --local --port 8787 --env-file backend/cloudflare.env
scripts.cloudflare:check: npm run cloudflare:d1:generate && npm run cloudflare:types && npx wrangler deploy --dry-run --config backend/wrangler.jsonc --env-file backend/cloudflare.env
